title: Marketplace: sale between two users (API)

items.check: Funded buyer buys a field offer at 123.45: 200 + transaction body
Field in buyer's GET /fields, gone from seller's
Offer active -> sold in my-offers; gone from buyer's and third user's browse
Same marketplace transaction in buyer's and seller's history, not in third user's
Buyer expense / seller income 123.45, category marketplace, in /financial/transactions and /financial/account
Balance exactly equal to price (50.25) buys; buyer ends at 0
Balance one cent below price refused 400, nothing changes
Balance 0 refused 400, nothing changes
Price 10.555 stored 10.56; buyer with 10.56 buys, with 10.55 refused
Funded seller buys own offer: 400, nothing changes
Sold offer bought again (same and other buyer): 404, no second payment
Two buyers concurrently: exactly one sale (1 + 3 rounds)
Same buyer 3 concurrent buys: one 200, debited once
Non-existent / missing / null / negative / object offerId refused, nothing changes
offerId as string of an active offer -> 404; offerId 0 -> 'Missing required field'
Malformed JSON body -> 500 on buy and other POSTs
No token -> 401, nothing changes; positive control with token succeeds
Malformed token -> 403 instead of 401
Cancelled offer cannot be bought (404), nothing changes
After sale seller cannot relist (404), buyer can
Seller deletes listed field; buy refused 404, buyer keeps funds
Latency: income 2.0 s, buy 4.1 s (observation)
Create offer returns 200 + message 201 instead of 201
Animal sale end to end: cow x3 moves to the buyer, 100->59.5 / 0->40.5, offer sold, both histories, third user's history empty, marketplace-stats +1 transaction / +40.5 volume
Listed animal moved onto a field before the buy: buy 404, offer unavailable, nothing paid
Seller deletes the listed field during an in-flight buy: buyer charged, no field, offer sold
Field and animal edited after listing are sold at the listed price (100 ha -> 0.01 ha; 10 cows -> 1 rat)
A non-owner (former owner or stranger) can POST /animals and /fields/assign onto another user's field (201); the owner's listing is then refused
DELETE /fields/:id by a non-owner answers 200 and wipes the owner's assignments; a non-existent id also answers 200
Seller adds animals to the field during an in-flight buy: the buyer receives an encumbered field and cannot relist it
Seller cancels during an in-flight buy: cancel 200 'cancelled', yet the sale completes and the offer is sold
Seller's staff assignment stays on the buyer's field after the sale
Buyer spends the balance in parallel with a buy (100: buy 80 + expense 50): buy 200, expense 400, balance 20

findings.title: Buyer pays and receives nothing when the seller deletes the field during the purchase (5/6)
Listed field/animal can be edited after listing; buyer pays the listed price for the edited item
Any user can attach animals and staff to another user's field, blocking its sale
DELETE /fields/:id by a non-owner answers 200 and wipes the owner's staff assignments
Create offer answers HTTP 200 with "message": 201 instead of HTTP 201
Malformed JSON body gets 500 Internal server error instead of 400 (app-wide)
Buy with offerId as a string answers 404 for an existing active offer
Invalid token on buy gets 403 instead of 401
Buyer receives a field holding the seller's animals when they are added during the purchase
Seller gets 'Offer cancelled successfully' but the offer is sold anyway (race)
Seller's staff assignment stays on the buyer's field after a sale
offerId 0 refused as 'Missing required field: offerId'
OpenAPI marketplace transaction history shape differs from the real response

assumptions: Money has 2 decimal places; check 10 relies on the stored rounded price.
'Offer no longer active' = status sold in my-offers and absent from browse.
'Appears in financial history' = one entry with category marketplace and amount = price; entries have referenceId null, so they cannot be linked to a specific sale.
Status codes for invalid ids, missing auth and malformed bodies follow testing-rules/api.md (not in the requirements).
lessons: Refusals checked against 12 read-back surfaces, not the status code alone.
Race check repeated (1 + 3 rounds) before calling the ledger lock reliable.
Tester prompt: transfer/ownership stories cover every item type and what the previous owner and others can do before, during and after the transfer.
"Changed by" assertions start every actor at a non-zero, non-round value (testing-rules/general.md, tester prompt).
QA settings install command runs `nvm use` first (CLAUDE.md).
struggles: First register failed: displayedName must be 3-20 chars of letters, digits, space, '-', '_' (my label was too long); shortened it in scratch/lib.mjs.
Income (POST /financial/transactions type income) requires a Luhn-valid cardNumber + cvv; used the published Visa test number in scratch/lib.mjs.
Harness blocked a plain `sleep 60` wait; waited with an until-loop on the probe log instead.
Writing report.md into the run folder was refused by the harness ('subagents should return findings as text'); its contents are returned in the tester's final message for the coordinator to save.
reviewer: update_plan was refused because subagents may not use it. No impact.
reviewer: no Playwright CLI problems; API-only story, no browser needed.
reviewer: assignment ids get reused after deletes (id 14 came up three times in different users' runs); noted only, not filed.
tester: the harness refused the subagent's write of report.md ('Subagents should return findings as text'); the coordinator saved it from the final message.
writer: npm ci in the worktree failed with EBADENGINE (shell Node 22, repo pins Node 26); every shell call needed `. ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use`, husky commits included.
writer: the handoff's recipe, endpoints and payloads were all correct; nothing had to be rediscovered.
writer: the bug file named in the create-offer workaround comment existed only untracked on main; the coordinator commits it with the run evidence.
test reviewer: the seller started at 0, so 'balance rises by the price' could not be told from 'set to the price'; fixed by funding the seller with 10 (expected 133.45).
